segments.t: GOOCHIAE Webb & Berthelot, 1840 古琦 For Mrs. Gooch, maiden name of the mother of 19th century English naturalist and geologist Philip B. Webb 以古琦女士命名,她是19​​世纪英国博物学家和地质学家菲利普B.韦伯(Philip B. Webb)的母亲.为了表示尊重,以原名音译.(另注:传统音译为"古奇",但"琦"字意为美玉,美好,在中国,女名qí音多用"琦"字.) P.S.韦伯先生是Aeonium属十分多品种的发现人.

©carlesjbox Synonyms : 异名: Sempervivum goochiae (Webb & Berthelot) Christ (1888) / Sempervivum tortuosum var. goochiae (Webb & Berthelot) Kuntze (1891) / Aldasorea goochiae (Webb & Berthelot) hort. ex Haage & Schmidt (1930) Section Chrysocome 克里斯康(音译)组 Distribution : Canary Islands (Nothern La Palma); 100 - 700 m. 分布:加那利群岛(拉帕尔马岛北部);海拔100 - 700m地区. Description (according to IHSP, 2003) : 描述(根据IHSP,2003): Perennial densely branched shrublets to 40 cm tall. 多年生灌木,密生,成株高度可达40cm. Branches 2 - 10 mm in diameter, pubescent, slightly viscid, smooth, without reticulations. 分枝直径2 - 10mm,被短柔毛,略有粘性,光滑,无网纹. Rosettes 3 - 12 cm in diameter, flattish, inner leaves ± erect. 莲座直径3 - 12cm,大致持平,内叶偶有直立. Leaves 1.5 - 5 x 1.5 - 2.5 cm, 1 - 2 mm thick, elliptic or circular, apically rounded or acute, retuse, basally cuneate, pubescent, viscid, pale green to yellowish green, occasionally reddish variegated. 叶长1.5 - 5cm,宽1.2 - 2.5cm,厚1 - 2mm,椭圆形或圆形,先端圆形或锐尖,微凹,基部楔形,被短柔毛,具有粘性.呈淡绿色至黄绿色,有时带红色的杂色. Inflorescences cymose panicles 2 - 5 x 3 - 11 cm, commonly 10- to 45-flowered, peduncle 1 - 2 cm, pedicels 1 - 15 mm, puberulent. 聚伞状圆锥花序,高2 - 5cm,宽3 - 11cm,通常有10 - 45朵花,花序梗长1 - 2cm,花梗长1 - 15mm,被微柔毛. Flowers 7- to 8-merous, sepals glandular-pubescent, petals 5 - 7 x 1 - 2 mm, oblanceolate, acute, very pale yellow or whitish, median part often pinkish variegated, filaments glabrous. 花基数7 - 8,萼片被腺柔毛,花瓣长5 - 7mm.宽1 - 2mm,倒披针形,尖锐.呈淡黄色或白色,中间部分常有粉红色的杂色,花丝无毛. Cytology : 2n = 36 染色体:2n=36 即 n=18
苗期goochiae ©neoecoAeonium goochiae 古琦 是Aeonium中较美的品种之一,亦是女神级Aeonium.其优雅婀娜的身姿,叶片的轻薄精致淡淡和草绿色,以及周身散发出的清香,无不为她增色. 资料来源:ICN 有谬误之处敬请指正.
